WITH observatory_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(telescope_count) as total_telescopes,
    COUNT(*) as total_observatories
  FROM observatory_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    oc.observstation,
    oc.telescope_count,
    oc.telescope_count * 1.0 / t.total_telescopes as share,
    1.0 / t.total_observatories as avg_share
  FROM observatory_counts oc
  CROSS JOIN totals t
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM with_shares
  WHERE share > avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(telescope_count) as combined_telescopes,
  AVG(share) as avg_share_above_avg,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_excess
FROM above_avg    -- Result: (66, 0.002173340358271866, 0.0010804441834084768)
